The Grate Escape
Every manhole is marked on the map

Applies when 'Players can change settings' is off. On: every road manhole in Knox Country is a travel destination from the start, dimmed on the map until visited. Off: players can only travel to manholes they have discovered in person.
Players can change settings

On: each player sets The Grate Escape up for themselves under Options - Mods, and the settings below are ignored. Off: everyone is pinned to the settings below. Leave this on for singleplayer - it is the only way to change anything on a world that already exists, since sandbox options can only be set when a world is created.
Sewer travel cost

Applies when 'Players can change settings' is off. Scales what every mile underground takes out of a traveller. 1.0 is the tuned baseline; 0.5 makes the sewers a cheap shortcut and 2.0 makes a cross-county run a real expedition. Ignored when travel is instant.
Travel between manholes is instant

Applies when 'Players can change settings' is off. On: picking a destination puts the player there at once, with no journey and no cost. Off: the trip runs manhole to manhole, and every mile underground costs food, water and stamina.
Require a crowbar to open manholes
Applies when 'Players can change settings' is off. On: prying a manhole open needs a crowbar or pry bar somewhere in the player's inventory. Off: bare hands will do.
Manhole covers can be seized shut

Applies when 'Players can change settings' is off. On: covers vary from free-lifting to badly rusted in, and getting a stubborn one open takes strength, fitness, a decent lever and fresh legs - a cover opened recently stays loose for about a month before it seizes again. Off: every cover lifts freely.

Every manhole is marked on the map

On: the sewer system is city infrastructure - every road manhole in Knox Country shows on the map as a destination, dimmed until you have actually been near it. Off: only manholes you have discovered in person can be traveled to. Ignored when a server has locked The Grate Escape settings.
Sewer travel cost

Scales what every mile underground takes out of you. 1.0 is the tuned baseline; 0.5 makes the sewers a cheap shortcut and 2.0 makes a cross-county run a real expedition. Ignored when travel is instant, or when a server has locked The Grate Escape settings.
Travel between manholes is instant

On: pick a destination and you are there, with no journey and no cost. Off: the trip runs manhole to manhole, stopping at each one so you can press on or climb out - every mile underground costs food, water and stamina, and none of it comes back until you surface. Ignored when a server has locked The Grate Escape settings.
Require a crowbar to open manholes

On: prying a manhole open needs a crowbar or pry bar somewhere in your inventory - the same tools that pry off a wooden barricade. Off: bare hands will do. Ignored when a server has locked The Grate Escape settings.
Manhole covers can be seized shut

On: covers vary from free-lifting to badly rusted in. Getting a stubborn one open takes strength, fitness, a decent lever and legs that are not spent - and every failed heave shifts it a little further, so no cover is ever truly stuck. A cover you have opened stays loose for about a month before it seizes again. Off: every cover lifts freely. Ignored when a server has locked The Grate Escape settings.
